name: daily-sales-tracker
description: Daily Sales Tracker with OCR receipt scanning, immutable audit logs, read-only share links, and automated cloud backups.

scripts.build: cd client && npm install && npm run build && cd .. && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.cpSync('client/dist', 'dist', {recursive: true}); fs.cpSync('client/dist', 'public', {recursive: true}); fs.mkdirSync('dist/admin', {recursive: true}); fs.copyFileSync('dist/index.html', 'dist/admin/index.html'); fs.mkdirSync('client/dist/admin', {recursive: true}); fs.copyFileSync('client/dist/index.html', 'client/dist/admin/index.html');"
scripts.vercel-build: cd client && npm install && npm run build && cd .. && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.cpSync('client/dist', 'dist', {recursive: true}); fs.cpSync('client/dist', 'public', {recursive: true}); fs.mkdirSync('dist/admin', {recursive: true}); fs.copyFileSync('dist/index.html', 'dist/admin/index.html'); fs.mkdirSync('client/dist/admin', {recursive: true}); fs.copyFileSync('client/dist/index.html', 'client/dist/admin/index.html');"
